title: New law: To amend the District of Columbia Home Rule Act to conform the District charter to revisions made by the Council of the District of Columbia relating to public education. (Public Law 110-33)
summary: H.R. 2080 of the 110th Congress became Public Law 110-33 on 2008-03-14.

title: New law: Higher Education Extension Act of 2008 (Public Law 110-198)
summary: S. 2733 of the 110th Congress became Public Law 110-198 on 2008-03-24.

title: New law: A joint resolution providing for the appointment of John W. McCarter as a citizen regent of the Board of Regents of the Smithsonian Institution. (Public Law 110-197)
summary: S.J.Res. 25 of the 110th Congress became Public Law 110-197 on 2008-03-14.

title: New law: A bill to extend agricultural programs beyond March 15, 2008, to suspend permanent price support authorities beyond that date, and for other purposes. (Public Law 110-196)
summary: S. 2745 of the 110th Congress became Public Law 110-196 on 2008-03-14.

title: New law: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service known as the Southpark Station in Alexandria, Louisiana, as the John "Marty" Thiels Southpark Station, in honor and memory of Thiels, a Louisiana postal worker who was killed in the line of duty on October 4, 2007. (Public Law 110-195)
summary: S. 2272 of the 110th Congress became Public Law 110-195 on 2008-03-12.

title: New law: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 59 Colby Corner in East Hampstead, New Hampshire, as the "Captain Jonathan D. Grassbaugh Post Office". (Public Law 110-194)
summary: S. 2478 of the 110th Congress became Public Law 110-194 on 2008-03-11.

title: New law: A bill to make technical corrections to the Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act. (Public Law 110-193)
summary: S. 2571 of the 110th Congress became Public Law 110-193 on 2008-03-06.
